signup.title: Create account
signup.headline: Start with your e-mail
signup.note: No password, no credit card. When the trial ends your data is packed as a ZIP and the download link is e-mailed to you (valid 7 days); the account is deleted right away.
signup.validityTitle: Trial accounts are valid for 3 days

signup.codeHint: If this e-mail already has a trial account, sign in instead. Right after a trial ends, deleting the account takes a few minutes; please sign up again a little later.

login.title: Sign in

login.note: Get a one-time code at the e-mail you signed up with — no password needed. First time here? Create a free trial account (valid for 3 days).

adminGate.recoveryIntro: You signed in with a recovery code. Before anything else, bind a new passkey (lost passkeys can be removed in Platform admin afterwards).
adminGate.setupIntro: The platform admin needs at least 2 passkeys and saved recovery codes. Verify with a bound passkey first, then bind a new one (preferably another device or a security key).

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains how OntoDecide Community Edition ("the platform") collects, uses, keeps and deletes your personal data when you sign up for and use a trial account. Please read it in full before signing up; you must accept it to create an account.

items.i1: Your e-mail address: for sign-up, sign-in codes and trial notifications.
items.i2: The business data you import into or create in your workspace.
items.i3: Technical data needed for security: IP address, browser type, time zone and request logs.
items.i4: We never collect passwords, phone numbers, ID documents or payment details.

items.i1: To provide the trial: create your workspace, run analyses and recommendations.
items.i2: To e-mail sign-in codes, trial expiry reminders and the trial-ended message with your data download link.
items.i3: To prevent abuse and fix faults: human checks, rate limits and runtime logs.
items.i4: Never for advertising; never sold or rented to anyone.

items.i1: Trial accounts are valid for 3 days: 72 hours from e-mail verification.
items.i2: When the trial ends (expiry, early termination or admin deletion) the workspace data is packed into one ZIP (encrypted at rest). The download link and a "delete now" link are e-mailed once and are valid for 7 days; then the ZIP is deleted for good.
items.i3: Once that e-mail is sent, business data, account, e-mail and sessions are deleted at once; platform backups and runtime logs expire within 7 days.

items.i1: Cloudflare: hosting, network protection and the Turnstile human check.
items.i2: Backblaze B2: storage of the ZIP archive after the trial.
items.i3: Resend / Brevo: e-mail delivery; delivery records are kept per their retention; click and open tracking is disabled.
items.i4: The web app loads no third-party analytics or advertising scripts.

items.i1: Only the session cookie needed to stay signed in (HttpOnly, Secure); no tracking cookies.
items.i2: Preferences such as language and theme are kept in your browser only.

items.i1: All traffic is encrypted with HTTPS.
items.i2: The platform admin can see any data and act on any account; every admin action is written to an append-only audit log.

items.i1: End the trial early at any time on the Account page; your data is then handled as in section 3.
items.i2: Delete the archive early with the "delete now" link in the e-mail.
items.i3: View and change your language and time zone on the Account page.

items.i1: If this notice changes we update the effective date above; material changes are announced on the sign-up and sign-in pages.
